description: This file defines the GoogleUser class which models a Google user's profile data within the OAuth2 client provider package. It provides methods to access user attributes like name, email, avatar, etc.

classes.name: GoogleUser
classes.description: Represents a Google user with methods to access profile information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleUser object with response data.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the user's first name, or null if not available.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the user's last name, or null if not available.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the user's locale, or null if not available.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the user's email address, or null if not available.

methods.name: getHostedDomain
methods.description: Returns the hosted domain, or null if not available.

methods.name: getAvatar
methods.description: Returns the URL of the user's avatar image, or null if not available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the entire response data as an array.

methods.name: getResponseValue
methods.description: Private helper to retrieve a specific value from the response; returns null if key does not exist.
